title: The Shatabdi Express
case_summary: Business tycoon Rajiv Malhotra was found strangled in his First Class cabin on the Delhi-Bhopal Shatabdi Express at 01:00. The train doors were locked, and the lights in the corridor were off. His briefcase of cash is missing.

victim.name: Rajiv Malhotra
victim.background: A ruthless businessman who destroyed local industries and bribed his way out of prison.
victim_relationships: Seema (Ex-Wife): Rajiv cheated her out of her family's wealth.
Rathore (Inspector): Rajiv got him suspended for refusing a bribe.
Vikram (Rival): Rajiv was about to buy out his company.
Tania (Journalist): Rajiv was suing her for defamation.

solution.logical_rule: Seema's alibi fails when the tie, briefcase, and cabin key are found.

suspects.name: Seema Malhotra
suspects.relationships: You hate Rajiv. You think Rathore is incompetent.

suspects.name: Inspector Rathore
suspects.relationships: You hate corruption. You suspect everyone.

suspects.name: Vikram Kapoor
suspects.secret: He tried to steal the briefcase.
suspects.alibi: Claims he was in the dining car.
suspects.relationships: You despise Rajiv. You respect Seema.

suspects.name: Tania Singh
suspects.relationships: You want justice. You think Vikram is a thief.

evidence.name: Silk Tie
evidence.description: Rajiv's tie, used as the murder weapon.

evidence.name: Duplicate Cabin Key
evidence.description: A key that can unlock Rajiv's cabin from the outside.

evidence.name: Signed Confession
evidence.description: A full breakdown and confession from the killer.
